name: MonoCode
use_label: One window for all your coding agents
one_liner: Tabbed desktop UI for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 5 more agents, on your own logins

text.why: MonoCode is a Tauri desktop app that runs eight agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, Pi, omp, fx) as long as they are installed and logged in; each tab is a session and the README states that MonoCode does not sell tokens. Builds exist for macOS (.dmg for Apple Silicon and Intel), Linux (.deb, AppImage) and Windows (NSIS installer).
text.take: It does one thing, turning several agent CLIs into tabs instead of terminal windows, and the README itself says "very early, expect bugs".
build: With Node.js 20+ and a Rust toolchain you can run it from source with npm run tauri dev, trim it to the agents your team uses, or fork it to add an adapter for a new CLI agent.

who.situation: one window of tabs instead of many terminals
compare and switch between the agents you already subscribe to
reference for wrapping CLI agents in a GUI

start.text: 1. Install and log in to at least one provider first: claude auth login / codex login / agent login
2. macOS (Apple Silicon): download MonoCode.dmg, open it, drag MonoCode to Applications
3. Linux: sudo apt install ./MonoCode_*.deb  or  chmod +x MonoCode_*.AppImage
4. Windows: download the NSIS installer from GitHub Releases and run it
5. From source: npm install, then npm run tauri dev

caveat: MIT. Distributed for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Linux x86_64 and Windows x86_64.
Each agent must be installed and logged in separately, and you pay each provider's subscription yourself.
The README says it is "very early and you should expect bugs".

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.
